notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.notes:
It's been a while, I've been working on my upcoming title "You Are The Code". Here's the 1.6 changelog:

[*] Added campaign completion achievement
[*] Added challenges completion achievement
[*] Added ThinkWithGames icon on title screen, linking to the ThinkWithGames Steam developer page
[*] Added titlescreen button that links to the steam page for the upcoming ThinkWithGames title "You Are The Code"
[*] Fixed save data being overridden when playing the demo after progressing in the main game
[*] Added icons to the level select button to make it more obvious that challenges exist there
[*] Changed button click sound

notes.title: Update 1.5 - Easy and Hard Puzzles are Split Up!
notes.notes:
Many users were having a hard time with the more difficult earlier levels, thus blocking them from seeing a majority of the game. To help with this, levels that were deemed a bit more on the challenging side have been moved to a new category in the level select screen "Challenges". 

Other changes:

[*] Made selected card stay above the others instead of sinking back to unselected cards level
[*] Added sound when adjusting the sound effect volume
[*] Adjusted end of demo text sequence
[*] Slight change to level 3
[*] Added translation for text for denying card pickup
[*] Made "deny card pickup" info box fade out when pressing undo
[*] Made deny sound play when clicking an invalid spot for rotator tokens
[*] Hint button flashing will not happen if a hint has already been used on that level (and the player has not left that level)
[*] The hint to press "Z" on the undo button is now clickable
[*] Added game version number to title screen
[*] "Buy the full game" text in the demo is now wavy

notes.title: Update 1.3

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
A free demo of the game is now available! Tell your friends!

Changes made in this update:

[list]
[*] Making these 6 levels easier
level 2
level 9
level 11
level 18
level 20
level 26
If you got stuck somewhere around these levels, try playing the new versions of these levels. They might help you understand the levels right after them.
[*] You can now pick up cards on levels with spades (only if pink cards have not been changed on that level)
[*] Fixed a bug where abilities could show behind black tiles
[*] Fixes related to keypress hint for moving to the next level
[*] Hovering over no level in level select now removes all highlighting
[/list]
